bodytaker.name: The Bodytaker
bodytaker.ability: Kill it and the thorn wall withers

warren.name: Archmage
warren.ability: Raises the dead every round. Kill him first.

clot.name: Zombie Clot
clot.ability: Its arms are balls of bodies: a landed blow slams you 3″, maybe into the chasm. The spore mushrooms feed it: pop all three to stop its healing.

tentacles.name: Tentacle
tentacles.ability: Lay it down on a hero in reach: grabbed.

kraken rises.name: The Kraken
kraken rises.ability: On a 5-6 at End round it dives and rises in another circle.

regrow.name: Tentacle
regrow.ability: Lay it down on a hero in reach: grabbed.

eye closes.title: The Eighth Gate
eye closes.text: The Kraken's last tentacle goes slack, and the great carved eye in the gate slowly closes. Ice cracks. Behind the gate, where there should be rock, a staircase of dark polished wood winds downward, and from somewhere far below comes a sound none of you expected: the scratch of a thousand pens. At the top of the stair, sitting on a crate he definitely did not have a minute ago, is the Rakshasa. He's holding a rolled contract tied with red ribbon. "Lovely work, that. Really lovely. Now. Who here can read fine print?"

counting house.title: The Counting House
counting house.text: The stair ends in a waiting room. Wooden benches, empty. A ticket dispenser on the wall reads NOW SERVING: 9,999,999. Past a long oak counter, rows of desks stretch into lamplit gloom, and at every desk a grey, translucent clerk is writing, writing, writing. None of them look up. Above the counter a brass plaque reads: ALL ACCOUNTS MUST BALANCE. The room smells of ink and old candles, and when you glance back at the stair, it is a little further away than it was.

contract.title: The Rakshasa's Contract
contract.text: He unrolls the contract across the counter with a flourish. "Simple job, mates. Up on that dais there's a book: the Great Ledger. Every debt ever owed this side of the Eighth Gate. That big squid you just flattened? It's in there. Overdue, see. Strike its line out and the gate stays shut for good, the house stops sending things up the stairs, and you lot get paid. Handsomely." He taps three empty boxes at the bottom of the page. "Only catch: the Ledger's locked. Three folios open it, and three very unpleasant employees are holding them. Auditor, Collector, and... well. The Defaulted. You'll know it when you smell it." He slides a pen across. "Sign here, here, and... there. Don't read that bit."

auditor.name: The Auditor
auditor.ability: Sees everything: Hidden doesn't work in its sight. Carries Folio I.

auditor.title: The Auditor
auditor.text: The office door swings open on its own. Behind the desk floats an enormous eye in a nest of wet, grasping roots, wearing a tiny pair of spectacles. "Irregularities," it says, without a mouth. "So many irregularities." Every one of you feels it counting you.

collector.name: The Collector
collector.ability: Interest compounds: it grows crueller as it bleeds. Carries Folio II and the strongroom key.

collector.title: The Collector
collector.text: The bars of the Collections Window slide up with a pleasant little chime. The thing behind it is lovely, lilac and smiling, with claws like letter openers. "Hello, darlings. You owe me. Not money, no. Just... a little interest."

defaulted.name: The Defaulted
defaulted.ability: Grows from unpaid debts: clerks keep stumbling out of its roots. Carries Folio III.

defaulted.title: The Defaulted
defaulted.text: The Archive of Bad Debts is a garden now. In its centre a vast pale flower has swallowed a desk, a chair and, judging by the shoes, its last clerk. It opens. The smell is the worst thing any of you have ever met.

surety falls.title: Paid in Full
surety falls.text: Old Surety sways. The last of the light goes out of his ink-dark eyes, and he sits down, heavily, on the edge of the dais. Then he starts to shrink. When it stops he is just a small grey gnome in a clerk's coat, very tired, holding a pen. "Paid in full," he whispers, and smiles for what looks like the first time in a thousand years. Behind him, the Great Ledger falls open on its own.

the ledger.title: The Great Ledger
the ledger.text: Three folios slot into three locks, and the Ledger turns its own pages to the very end. Two lines in red ink, both OVERDUE. The first: THE DEEP ONE OF THE EIGHTH GATE. Owed: one sky. The second is in a smaller, neater hand you recognise from a certain contract: RAKSHASA, MERCHANT. Owed: one soul, his own, signed over for a fortune he spent long ago. Collection: imminent. Behind you a familiar voice clears its throat, very quietly. "Ah. Right. So. About that." The pen is in your hand. There's ink enough for one line.

strike rakshasa.title: Struck: the Rakshasa
strike rakshasa.text: The nib scratches through his name. For a moment nothing happens; then the Rakshasa makes a sound none of you have heard from him before, a long, shaky breath out. "You... you mad, beautiful idiots. You had the squid dead to rights." He straightens his coat and won't quite look at you. "Right. Well. My stall's your stall. Half price, for life. And I'll find you. I always find you. But now it's a good thing." Far above, very faintly, the Eighth Gate's eye begins to open again.

strike kraken.title: Struck: the Kraken
strike kraken.text: The nib scratches through the Deep One's line, and far above you a sound like a mountain settling rolls down the stair: the Eighth Gate sealing for good. The Rakshasa smiles his widest smile. "Lovely. Job done. Payment as promised." He counts it out to the last coin, perfectly fair. Then he leans in close. "You read my page." The smile doesn't move. "I won't forget that, mates. Not ever." He's gone before the lamp stops swinging.

doom red.name: Red Stack: Arrears
doom red.ability: Arrears: angrier the longer it is left unpaid. Grinds 2 squares down the hall each End round; crushes what it can't push (400).

doom red.title: The hall seals
doom red.text: Behind you a shelf grinds shut with a sound like a ledger slamming. At the far end of the hall, the red shelf you chose turns to face you, and begins, very slowly, to move.

doom blue.name: Blue Stack: Compound Interest
doom blue.ability: Compound Interest: keeps growing back. Grinds 2 squares down the hall each End round; crushes what it can't push (400).

doom blue.title: The hall seals
doom blue.text: Behind you a shelf grinds shut with a sound like a ledger slamming. At the far end of the hall, the blue shelf you chose turns to face you, and begins, very slowly, to move.

doom green.name: Green Stack: Liabilities
doom green.ability: Liabilities: more debtors keep arriving. Grinds 2 squares down the hall each End round; crushes what it can't push (400).

doom green.title: The hall seals
doom green.text: Behind you a shelf grinds shut with a sound like a ledger slamming. At the far end of the hall, the green shelf you chose turns to face you, and begins, very slowly, to move.

doom black.name: Black Stack: Bad Debt
doom black.ability: Bad Debt: bursts when written off. In a 1-wide hall, nobody is far enough away. Grinds 2 squares down the hall each End round; crushes what it can't push (400).

doom black.title: The hall seals
doom black.text: Behind you a shelf grinds shut with a sound like a ledger slamming. At the far end of the hall, the black shelf you chose turns to face you, and begins, very slowly, to move.

doom gold.name: Gold Stack: Assets
doom gold.ability: Assets: well protected. Grinds 2 squares down the hall each End round; crushes what it can't push (400).

doom gold.title: The hall seals
doom gold.text: Behind you a shelf grinds shut with a sound like a ledger slamming. At the far end of the hall, the gold shelf you chose turns to face you, and begins, very slowly, to move.

the stacks.title: The Filing Stacks
the stacks.text: Past the clerks, the shelves rise higher than any shelves should, and the aisles between them are exactly one person wide. There is a gap in the wall of books, just the one, and through it you can see a small clear room. It looks safe. It looks like the only way on. Somewhere deep in the stacks, something heavy is sliding across the floorboards.

the hub.title: The Hub
the hub.text: The moment the last of you steps through, the floor shudders and the stacks turn behind you like the wards of a lock. The gap is gone. Three openings remain, each plugged by a single squat shelf of coloured books: one shelf to a doorway, as if the house is asking you to choose your debt.
